channel.description: Databases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: From Alert to Online Repack: A Playbook for Postgres Table Bloat
item.description: I ran a experiment on my own Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server: deliberately bloat a table, build a monitoring job that would catch it, and then... (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: UUIDs Stored as text: What It Costs in Postgres 18
item.description: Same 5 million UUIDs, stored as uuid and as text. The text index was 88% bigger, one level deeper, and every lookup read one more page. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Postgres FM had Álvaro on the same day
Why Materialize Dropped SERIALIZABLE for 3x Write Throughput
item.description: A linearizable metadata log for Materialize, built on PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED isolation, with 3x write throughput and a Lean 4 proof. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Reducing Storage Initialization Impact in Amazon RDS After Snapshot Restore
item.description: When you restore an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL instance from a snapshot, the Amazon EBS volume hydrates lazily, so early queries can run 10x to 15x slower. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Free live workshop
item.description: In this hands-on workshop, you'll wire Tiger MCP into the coding agent you already use and give it a database it's allowed to break. (1 source: postgresweekly)
